chunks: Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The man cannot perform li'an (cursing) with the woman with the woman whom he is temporarily married to.
ai.seo_question: Can a man perform li'an with his temporary wife in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that li'an (ritual swearing of innocence in cases of unproven adultery) is inapplicable to temporary marriage (mut'ah), distinguishing its legal framework from permanent marriage. Scholars note this implies that the specific procedural mechanism for li'an, which requires a permanent marital bond, does not extend to the time-bound contract of mut'ah, thereby affecting how divorce and paternity disputes are handled in Shia jurisprudence.
